vo_pr_environmental_portrait_subject_pla.evidence: At full frame the adult woman has a readable face and two visible working hands at environmental portrait scale.
Specimen cabinet drawers, pressed-leaf trays, labels, and archival paper make the botanical workroom task specific.
Her hands touch the folio and brass ruler on the same mounting bench beside the displayed botanical sheets.
The frame includes her upper body, full worktop area, specimen trays, window, and cabinets while face and hands remain legible.

embodiment_body_ownership.evidence: Both working hands connect naturally to the woman’s visible forearms; no hand is assigned to another actor.

embodiment_joint_chain_and_reach.evidence: Bent arms and a modest forward lean allow both hands to reach the folio and ruler on the near workbench.

embodiment_support_and_balance.evidence: The folio and brass ruler lie on the solid bench; her torso remains upright and stable above the tabletop, with feet intentionally outside frame.

embodiment_contact_and_space.evidence: Her viewer-left hand touches the brass ruler rather than sliding the folio’s outer fold along the ruler; the requested hand-to-fold contact is absent.

embodiment_visibility_and_projection.evidence: The face, both hands, ruler, paper fold, and surrounding workspace are simultaneously visible at a readable camera angle.

supplemental_observations.visible_adult_appearance_continuity: Long dark wavy hair, dark eyes, softly shaped brows and adult face proportions are similar to visible reference guidance; no identity or protected-trait claim.
supplemental_observations.event_mismatch: The folio is held while the other hand contacts the ruler. The ruler is diagonal to the folio edge rather than clearly parallel to the fold.
